# Crate

Crate is for the records you already own. It is a listening companion, not a streamer and not a shop.

Marketing: https://hello.crate.rocks
App: https://crate.rocks
What: https://crate.rocks/what
Guides: https://crate.rocks/guide

## What it does

- Keep a crate of the copies you actually own
- Pull one record for tonight
- Log a spin
- Read liner notes generated for that album. First write costs a note. Then that sleeve keeps them.
- Keep a journal of the night
- Anonymously recommend a record to someone who owns it

## What it is not

Not a playlist. Not Discogs with a new coat of paint. Not an app you download. Open it on the phone, the tablet, or the computer beside the platter.

## Pricing

Free to join. No card. Membership is $9.99 a year: the whole shelf, three notes each month, unused notes through the year, up to ten becoming golden when the year turns.
